name: stltosolid
description: Turn STL and OBJ meshes and dimensioned drawings into real CAD solids: STEP files and Fusion 360 scripts.
long_description:
stlToSolid gives an AI assistant the tools of the stlToSolid app. It can look at a mesh, convert it to a STEP with true planes, cylinders and fillets, loft smooth shapes, trace cross-sections into Fusion 360 sketches, and build a parametric part from a drawing it reads.

First start: the geometry kernel is a large download, about 2.8 GB, and the first start takes a few minutes. Later starts take under a second.

Free for personal, hobby, educational and research use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0). Commercial use needs the author's permission.

out_dir.title: Results folder
out_dir.description: Where STEP files and Fusion scripts are saved. Nothing is ever overwritten.

allow_code.title: Allow the CadQuery tool
allow_code.description: Lets the assistant run CadQuery scripts it writes, for shapes a recipe cannot draw. Scripts run in their own process under an allow-list, with a time limit and no file access.

tools.name: inspect_mesh
tools.description: Look at a mesh: size, bodies, and a suggested method.

tools.name: convert_mesh
tools.description: Convert a mesh to a STEP solid.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Where a conversion or build stands.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Stop a running conversion or build.

tools.name: suggest_loft_axis
tools.description: Which axis a loft would slice along.

tools.name: trace_section
tools.description: Slice a mesh at one plane and see the outline.

tools.name: plan_xray
tools.description: Where a stack of section planes would go.

tools.name: xray_fusion_script
tools.description: A Fusion 360 script with one sketch per slice.

tools.name: inspect_step
tools.description: Read a STEP back the way CAD will.

tools.name: preview_recipe
tools.description: Check a Blueprint recipe and draw it from four sides.

tools.name: build_recipe
tools.description: Build a recipe into a STEP and a parametric Fusion script.

tools.name: build_cadquery
tools.description: Run a CadQuery script under an allow-list and write a STEP. Off unless enabled.

tools.name: fusion_handoff
tools.description: The Python to run a result through Autodesk's Fusion MCP server.

prompts.name: convert-for-fusion
prompts.description: Inspect a mesh, convert it and check the result.
prompts.text: Convert ${arguments.path} into a solid I can model against in Fusion 360.

prompts.name: read-drawing
prompts.description: Build a part from a dimensioned drawing.
prompts.text: Build a part from the drawing at ${arguments.drawing_path}.

prompts.name: send-to-fusion
prompts.description: Run a result in the open Fusion design.
prompts.text: Put ${arguments.path} into my open Fusion 360 design.
